text: This report details the progress of implementation of the Downtown East Five Year Action Plan. The Downtown East Action Plan was developed to address a number of complex and entrenched challenges in the area related to poverty, homelessness, housing, community safety, mental health and substance use, particularly the drug poisoning crisis. Implementation of the plan began in July 2019 following City Council approval of the Five Year Action Plan and a Work Plan to guide the first phase of work. The majority of actions in the Work Plan have been advanced, although the COVID-19 pandemic has impacted the trajectory of implementation as many City and community serviced were required to pivot to address critical needs and deep vulnerabilities across Toronto.
